mapper.sql: id, source_code, source_type, base_url, enabled, requests_per_second, max_concurrency, connect_timeout_seconds, response_timeout_seconds, max_retries, max_response_bytes, compliance_note, last_success_at, last_failure_at, consecutive_failures, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_source WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode}
SELECT FROM data_source ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM data_source WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_source ( source_code, source_type, base_url, adapter_code, enabled, requests_per_second, max_concurrency, connect_timeout_seconds, response_timeout_seconds, max_retries, max_response_bytes, compliance_note, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceCode}, #{sourceType}, #{baseUrl}, CASE #{sourceType} WHEN 'OPENALEX' THEN 'OPENALEX_REST_V1' ELSE 'CROSSREF_REST_V1' END, #{enabled}, #{requestsPerSecond}, #{maxConcurrency}, #{connectTimeoutSeconds}, #{responseTimeoutSeconds}, #{maxRetries}, #{maxResponseBytes}, #{complianceNote}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE data_source SET requests_per_second = #{row.requestsPerSecond}, max_concurrency = #{row.maxConcurrency}, connect_timeout_seconds = #{row.connectTimeoutSeconds}, response_timeout_seconds = #{row.responseTimeoutSeconds}, max_retries = #{row.maxRetries}, max_response_bytes = #{row.maxResponseBytes}, compliance_note = #{row.complianceNote}, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{row.id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE data_source SET last_success_at = CASE WHEN #{reachable} THEN #{checkedAt} ELSE last_success_at END, last_failure_at = CASE WHEN #{reachable} THEN last_failure_at ELSE #{checkedAt} END, consecutive_failures = CASE WHEN #{reachable} THEN 0 ELSE consecutive_failures + 1 END, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
